executed_path: visible Instagram DM receipt in Safari DOM
root_cause: An opaque spatial pointer could be washed into resolved context by a prior generic acknowledgement or concrete but dimension-incompatible history.
A candidate could claim understanding before asking a clarification, and the later question could incorrectly wash the false-understanding prefix.
The global size and placement question filter could delete the clarification required by the frozen RESOLVE_CONTEXT route, exhausting retries into silence.
general_fix: Require a dimension-compatible current anchor before a spatial directional pointer can be resolved.
Reject the entire packet when it claims understanding, approval, or evaluation before the missing referent is identified.
Require one open identification question; unresolved placeholder choices such as same/new or this/that do not satisfy the gate.
Preserve a verifier-approved clarification through the route-aware post-filter while keeping ordinary size and placement probing restricted.
Keep an open form offer pending through non-consent placement or timing details and send the form only after grounded current-turn consent.
